(function () {
  "use strict";
  var API = LukeAnimate;
  var TOOL_ID = String((item && (item.id || item.label)) || "Lip_Service");
  var GROUP_ID = String((group && group.id) || "animate");
  var PANEL_ID = "lukeanimate-lip-service-panel";
  var STYLE_ID = "lukeanimate-lip-service-host-style";
  if (!API || Number(API.version || 0) < 111) throw new Error("Lip Service requires LukeAnimate Plugin API version 111 or newer.");
  if (typeof API.getLipServiceTargets !== "function" || typeof API.applyLipServiceSequence !== "function") throw new Error("This LukeAnimate index does not contain the Lip Service integration API.");

  var existing = document.getElementById(PANEL_ID);
  if (existing) { existing.style.display = "flex"; existing.style.zIndex = String(nextZ()); API.setConfiguredToolActive(GROUP_ID, TOOL_ID, true); return; }
  installStyle();

  var panel = document.createElement("section");
  panel.id = PANEL_ID;
  panel.className = "la-lip-host";
  panel.innerHTML = '<header class="la-lip-host-header"><div class="la-lip-host-title"><strong>Lip Service</strong><span>Audio mouth timing for LukeAnimate</span></div><div class="la-lip-host-actions"><button class="la-lip-back" type="button" title="Close Lip Service and return to the stage">Back to Stage</button><button class="la-lip-close" type="button" title="Close Lip Service" aria-label="Close Lip Service">×</button></div></header><iframe title="Lip Service"></iframe>';
  document.body.appendChild(panel);
  panel.style.zIndex = String(nextZ());
  API.setConfiguredToolActive(GROUP_ID, TOOL_ID, true);

  window.LukeAnimateLipServiceHost = {
    getTargets: function () { return API.getLipServiceTargets(); },
    getFPS: function () { return API.fps; },
    getCurrentFrame: function () { return API.getCurrentFrame(); },
    apply: function (payload) { return API.applyLipServiceSequence(payload); },
    clear: function (targetKey) { return API.clearLipServiceSequence(targetKey); },
    close: function () { closePanel(); },
    log: function (message) { API.log(String(message)); }
  };

  var iframe = panel.querySelector("iframe");
  iframe.srcdoc = decodeBase64Utf8("");
  panel.querySelector(".la-lip-back").addEventListener("click", closePanel);
  panel.querySelector(".la-lip-close").addEventListener("click", closePanel);
  panel.addEventListener("pointerdown", function () { panel.style.zIndex = String(nextZ()); });
  makeDraggable(panel, panel.querySelector(".la-lip-host-header"));
  document.addEventListener("keydown", onLipServiceKeyDown);

  function onLipServiceKeyDown(event) {
    if (event.key !== "Escape") return;
    event.preventDefault();
    closePanel();
  }

  function closePanel() {
    document.removeEventListener("keydown", onLipServiceKeyDown);
    if (panel && panel.parentNode) panel.parentNode.removeChild(panel);
    try { delete window.LukeAnimateLipServiceHost; } catch (error) { window.LukeAnimateLipServiceHost = null; }
    API.setConfiguredToolActive(GROUP_ID, TOOL_ID, false);
    try { API.openPanel("particles"); } catch (error) {}
    try {
      if (API.canvas) {
        API.canvas.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
        API.canvas.focus({ preventScroll:true });
      }
    } catch (error) {}
  }
  function decodeBase64Utf8(value) {
    var binary = atob(value), bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for (var i = 0; i < binary.length; i += 1) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
    return new TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(bytes);
  }
  function nextZ() {
    var highest = 12000;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".la-lip-host"), function (node) {
      var value = parseInt(window.getComputedStyle(node).zIndex, 10);
      if (Number.isFinite(value)) highest = Math.max(highest, value);
    });
    return highest + 1;
  }
  function installStyle() {
    if (document.getElementById(STYLE_ID)) return;
    var style = document.createElement("style");
    style.id = STYLE_ID;
    style.textContent = [
      ".la-lip-host{position:fixed;inset:42px 14px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.26);z-index:12001}",
      ".la-lip-host-header{height:42px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex:0 0 42px;padding:6px 8px 6px 12px;background:var(--panel-2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);cursor:move;user-select:none;touch-action:none}",
      ".la-lip-host-title{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;min-width:0}",
      ".la-lip-host-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex:0 0 auto}",
      ".la-lip-host-header strong{font-size:13px;color:var(--text)}",
      ".la-lip-host-header span{font:10.5px var(--mono);color:var(--text-dim)}",
      ".la-lip-host-header button{height:30px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;background:var(--panel);color:var(--text-dim);cursor:pointer}",
      ".la-lip-host-header button:hover{border-color:var(--accent-dim);color:var(--accent);background:var(--panel-2)}",
      ".la-lip-back{width:auto!important;padding:0 12px!important;font:600 11px var(--font)!important;line-height:28px!important}",
      ".la-lip-close{width:30px!important;padding:0!important;font-size:20px!important;line-height:1!important}",
      ".la-lip-host iframe{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;border:0;background:#eef0f3}",
      "@media(max-width:700px){.la-lip-host{inset:8px}.la-lip-host-header span{display:none}.la-lip-back{padding:0 8px!important}}"
    ].join("\n");
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }
  function makeDraggable(target, handle) {
    var drag = null;
    handle.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (event) {
      if (event.target.closest("button")) return;
      var rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
      drag = { id:event.pointerId, dx:event.clientX-rect.left, dy:event.clientY-rect.top, width:rect.width, height:rect.height };
      handle.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      target.style.right = "auto"; target.style.bottom = "auto";
      event.preventDefault();
    });
    handle.addEventListener("pointermove", function (event) {
      if (!drag || drag.id !== event.pointerId) return;
      var left = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerWidth-drag.width, event.clientX-drag.dx));
      var top = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerHeight-drag.height, event.clientY-drag.dy));
      target.style.left = left + "px"; target.style.top = top + "px";
    });
    function end(event) { if (drag && drag.id === event.pointerId) { drag = null; try { handle.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) {} } }
    handle.addEventListener("pointerup", end); handle.addEventListener("pointercancel", end);
  }
})();
